data.author: Priya Nair
data.summary: A beginner-friendly walkthrough of reading JSON with Python's standard library.
data.text: The json module turns text into dictionaries and lists in one call. Use json.loads for strings and json.load for files, then access fields with normal indexing. Handle missing keys with .get to avoid crashes.
data.title: Parsing JSON in Python

data.author: Lena Ortiz
data.summary: A short guide to building resilient habits without relying on motivation alone.
data.text: Motivation fades, but systems endure. Start by shrinking the task until it feels almost trivial, then anchor it to an existing cue in your day. Track completion, not intensity, and review weekly to adjust.
data.title: Small Systems Beat Big Motivation

data.author: Marcus Chen
data.summary: Why distributed teams should document decisions, not just outcomes.
data.text: When a decision is recorded with its context and trade-offs, future teammates can revisit it without re-litigating. Keep decision logs short, dated, and linked to the work they affect.
data.title: Decision Logs for Remote Teams
